page_title: MON 0-0 VER | Monza v Verona 11/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Davide Massa is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Davide Massa blows his whistle and signals a foul after Andrea Colpani (Monza) brought his opponent down.
90+3' Monza keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Rough tackle by Ondrej Duda (Verona). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
88' The current number of shots on goal is 1:1.
87' Davide Massa blows his whistle after Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
87' A player from Monza brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
85' Andrea Carboni (Monza) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
85' Monza have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
82' A player from Verona commits a rough challenge. Davide Massa blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
79' Substitution. Pawel Dawidowicz leaves the pitch and is replaced by Diego Coppola (Verona).
78' Andrea Carboni (Monza) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
77' Referee Davide Massa sees the trip by Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
77' Monza enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
74' Substitution. Pedro Pereira (Monza) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Samuele Birindelli walks off.
72' The game has come to an end for Darko Lazovic. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Daniel Silva (Verona).
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Warren Bondo departs the field of play to be replaced by Roberto Gagliardini (Monza).
70' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) replaces Alessio Zerbin.
70' Referee Davide Massa reverses his original decision after the VAR review. There was no infringement and subsequently it’s not a penalty.
70' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.
69' A player from Verona takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a penalty to Monza! They have a good chance to score now.
68' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Monza comes to nothing.
67' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Michael Folorunsho (Verona) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
64' A wild pass somehow finds Suat Serdar (Verona) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
64' Verona are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
63' Here is a change. Lorenzo Colombo is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Milan Djuric (Monza).
62' Substitution. Dany Mota did his best and is replaced by Valentin Carboni (Monza).
60' Warren Bondo (Monza) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
58' Fabien Centonze (Verona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Davide Massa had an easy-decision to make.
57' We are about to witness a subsitution. Fabien Centonze (Verona) for Jackson Tchatchoua.
57' Marco Baroni decides to make a substitution. Karol Swiderski will be replaced by Federico Bonazzoli (Verona).
56' Monza can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
55' Suat Serdar (Verona) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
53' Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) makes a rough challenge and Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Monza are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
48' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monza.
46' Marco Baroni has made a change at the break. Ruben Vinagre has come on in place of Tijjani Noslin (Verona).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
44' Verona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
40' Monza are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
37' Monza failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
37' Unbelievable miss! Suat Serdar (Verona) reacts superbly to latch on to a rebound, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
34' A cross from a corner kick by Verona is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
33' The Monza players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
30' Darko Lazovic (Verona) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
29' Foul! Warren Bondo (Monza) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
28' Ondrej Duda (Verona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Davide Massa has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
25' Alessio Zerbin (Monza) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul.

24' Golden opportunity! Andrea Colpani (Monza) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
22' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Davide Massa no option but to blow his whistle.
22' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) makes a slide tackle, but referee Davide Massa blows for a foul.
20' Andrea Colpani (Monza) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Lorenzo Montipo, who pulls off a stunning save!
16' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
13' Davide Massa blows for a foul after Andrea Colpani (Monza) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
11' None of the Monza players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

9' A clever short pass gives Michael Folorunsho (Verona) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
7' Darko Lazovic (Verona) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
5' A goal, which was scored by Lorenzo Colombo (Monza), was disallowed due to offside.
4' Great teamplay by Monza as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
2' Close! Darko Lazovic (Verona) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Monza will have the kick-off.
Davide Massa is the one to supervise the game today.
